roles.name: --accent
roles.purpose: a highlighted menu row in an overlay; the light outline and ghost hovers take it

roles.name: --accent-foreground
roles.purpose: text on an accent surface

roles.name: --background
roles.purpose: the document's ground beneath the app shell, which paints `surface` over it, and the resting fill of an outline button and a switch thumb — never an overlay's fill

roles.name: --border
roles.purpose: frames and lines: a frame on a resting container and the splits between its sections, a line on controls and between rows

roles.name: --disabled-foreground
roles.purpose: text and icons on a disabled control

roles.name: --feedback-danger
roles.purpose: an error message — a failed save, a field that will not take its value — as text

roles.name: --ghost-hover
roles.purpose: a borderless (ghost) control under the pointer

roles.name: --input
roles.purpose: the border of a field — 3:1 against the card and the canvas, so a field's edge is seen

roles.name: --line-height-body
roles.purpose: prose, rows, labels and controls
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --line-height-caption
roles.purpose: the smallest type roles: metadata, badges, field errors, nav items, the status strip
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --muted-foreground
roles.purpose: secondary text — hints, metadata. L .50 is the lightest that clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) on every surface muted text sits on, muted and accent included

roles.name: --popover
roles.purpose: every true overlay — dialog, popover, dropdown — with shadow-overlay

roles.name: --primary
roles.purpose: the brand fill: the one primary action per view, the active nav item

roles.name: --primary-foreground
roles.purpose: text and icons on a primary fill

roles.name: --primary-hover
roles.purpose: a primary fill under the pointer

roles.name: --radius-control
roles.purpose: a thing that IS content: a button, a field, a nav item

roles.name: --radius-stamp
roles.purpose: a mark inside content: a badge, a match highlight, a checkbox

roles.name: --ring
roles.purpose: the focus ring

roles.name: --size-control
roles.purpose: a field, a default button; taller under a touch pointer
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --size-field-inset
roles.purpose: a field's text in from its side edges — and the inset that lines plain figures up with a typed one
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --step-12
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --step-14
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-body
roles.purpose: running text, cells, hints, metadata
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-emphasis
roles.purpose: a column heading, a field error, a nav group, the status strip, a table footer
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: scroll-region
roles.purpose: A region that scrolls vertically inside its own box, with the bar hidden. `position: relative` is load-bearing: without it an `sr-only` label inside the region is positioned against the page and gives the whole screen a scrollbar. Use this — never a bare `overflow-y-auto`.

roles.name: type-body
roles.purpose: prose — descriptions, list text, dialog text
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-14); font-weight: var(--weight-body); line-height: var(--line-height-body)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-metadata
roles.purpose: the secondary line beside or under a title — an email, a count, a range
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-12); font-weight: var(--weight-body); line-height: var(--line-height-caption)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.
